serialize_model_with_pickle: create a python module that uses SimplePickleSerializer to serialize an sklearn model to bytes
deserialize_model_from_pickle: create a python module that uses SimplePickleSerializer to deserialize bytes back into an sklearn model
serialize_for_zippy: create a python module that calls serialize_for_zippy to pickle an object for Zippydb storage
deserialize_from_zippy: create a python module that calls deserialize_from_zippy to restore a pickled object from Zippydb bytes
